description: Active service business with a frequent, high-impact operational problem, sufficient budget, decision authority, and near-term timeline.

input.name: Test Person 01
input.problem: We manually review and route new client intake forms to the right consultant. It takes several hours each week and delays follow-up.
input.business_impact: Leads sometimes wait a full business day for a response, and my team spends too much time on repetitive administrative work.
input.desired_outcome: Automatically review the intake information, route each lead to the right consultant, and notify the team so follow-up happens faster.

required_reasoning_points: The business is actively operating.
The problem is repetitive and occurs daily.
The problem has meaningful operational impact.
The requested outcome is a plausible automation use case.
The budget is above the $3,000 starting price.
The applicant can approve the investment.
The timeline is within 90 days.

description: Lead describes a significant recurring problem but contradicts that description by saying the process rarely occurs and has almost no impact.

input.business_impact: It has almost no impact on the business.

required_reasoning_points: The application contains contradictory statements about frequency.
The stated business impact conflicts with the description of a major bottleneck.
The desired savings also conflict with the reported low frequency.
The contradictions should be resolved before automatic qualification.
